name: @funcd-dev/example-env-echo
description: A funcd config+secret example (ADR-0093/0057): a void-input function that echoes the env injected by its bindings — spec.config (a ConfigMap) and spec.secrets (a Secret) — proving both reach the running handler (and the Secret wins a key present in both). Authored in TypeScript against @funcd-dev/shim; vite build (@funcd-dev/vite-plugin) bundles it to a self-contained env-echo.mjs; the I/O contract lives in funcdctl.yaml.
